description: Header file defining the ngap_impl class, which implements the ngap_interface for NGAP protocol handling, including message processing, UE context management, and connection handling within a 5G core network component.

classes.name: ngap_impl
classes.description: Final class implementing NGAP protocol handling, including message processing, UE context management, and connection handling within a 5G core network component.

classes.name: tx_pdu_notifier_with_logging
classes.description: Nested class providing logging capabilities for NGAP message notifications, managing connection state and message forwarding.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new NGAP message is received, with optional logging.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a decorated message notifier for logging or additional processing.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the current message notifier.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Checks if a message notifier is currently connected.

methods.description: Processes an NGAP initiating message.

methods.description: Handles a PDU Session Resource Modify Request message.

methods.description: Handles a PDU Session Resource Release Command message.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_release_command
methods.description: Handles a UE Context Release Command message.

methods.name: handle_paging
methods.description: Handles a Paging NGAP message.

methods.name: send_handover_failure
methods.description: Sends a handover failure message to the AMF.

methods.description: Processes a Handover Request message.
